FROM job_info j WHERE 1=1 AND ( (#{userHealth1} = 'N' OR j.job_health1_restrict = 'N') AND (#{userHealth2} = 'N' OR j.job_health2_restrict = 'N') AND (#{userHealth3} = 'N' OR j.job_health3_restrict = 'N') AND (#{userHealth4} = 'N' OR j.job_health4_restrict = 'N') AND (#{userHealth5} = 'N' OR j.job_health5_restrict = 'N') AND (#{userHealth6} = 'N' OR j.job_health6_restrict = 'N') AND (#{userHealth7} = 'N' OR j.job_health7_restrict = 'N') AND (#{userHealth8} = 'N' OR j.job_health8_restrict = 'N') ) ORDER BY j.created_at DESC
